# Implementation Plan: App Push Notifications

**Branch**: `feature/push-notifications` | **Date**: 2026-07-30 | **Spec**: [spec.md](spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/008-push-notifications/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan is generated by `/speckit-plan`. See `.specify/templates/plan-template.md` for the execution workflow.

---

## Summary

Implement Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) Push Notifications for the SmartFlow Android App, triggered by critical events (Dry Run, Overflow, Countdown Finish) from the ESP32.

---

## Constitution Gate *(must pass before Phase 0)*

| Principle | Status | Evidence |
|-----------|--------|----------|
| I. Fail Toward Pump OFF | ☐ Pass / ☑ N/A | Does not affect relay logic. |
| II. Dry-Run Lockout | ☐ Pass / ☑ N/A | |
| III. Overflow Protection | ☐ Pass / ☑ N/A | |
| IV. TOR Independence | ☐ Pass / ☑ N/A | |
| V. Sensor Freshness / E-Stop | ☐ Pass / ☑ N/A | |
| VI. Backward Compatibility | ☑ Pass / ☐ N/A | RTDB changes are purely additive (FCM tokens). |

## Phase 1: Design

### Phase 1B: Firebase Contract Design
- [ ] Define additive RTDB schema nodes: `/devices/{deviceId}/fcmTokens/{token}: true`
- [ ] Define Cloud Function triggers: `onValueCreate` at `/devices/{deviceId}/events/{eventId}`

### Phase 1C: Dashboard Design
- [ ] Implement `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` permission request on Android 13+.
- [ ] Fetch FCM token on launch and write to RTDB.

---

## Phase 3: Android App Implementation

- [ ] [DB-001] Update `AndroidManifest.xml` with `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` permission and ensure FCM service is registered.
- [ ] [DB-002] Update `MainActivity.kt` to request notification permissions at runtime.
- [ ] [DB-003] Update `FirebaseDeviceRepository.kt` with a `registerFcmToken(token: String)` function to save tokens to `devices/{deviceId}/fcmTokens`.
- [ ] [DB-004] Refactor `SmartFlowMessagingService.kt` to save token via the repository/proper device path.

---

## Phase 4: Cloud Functions Implementation

**Build**: `cd functions && npm run build`

### Implementation
- [ ] [FN-001] Create a Firebase trigger in `functions/src/index.ts` to listen to new entries in `devices/{deviceId}/events/{eventId}`.
- [ ] [FN-002] Extract event `type` and if it matches critical conditions (`dry_run_error`, `overflow_error`, `countdown_finished`), fetch `devices/{deviceId}/fcmTokens`.
- [ ] [FN-003] Use `admin.messaging().sendEachForMulticast` to push notifications to all registered tokens and cleanup invalid tokens.

---

## Phase 5: Integration & Polish

- [ ] End-to-end test: Trigger an event via Firebase console, confirm Android device receives a push notification.
- [ ] Commit with Conventional Commits message: `feat(app,functions): implement push notifications`
